name: pr-review-queue
description: Shows the GitHub pull requests waiting on your review above the prompt, and starts a review when you pick one

aidPath.title: AID.review-queue command
aidPath.description: The AID.review-queue executable, by name on PATH or as an absolute path.

owner.title: GitHub owner
owner.description: The organization or user whose pull requests are listed. Empty lets AID.review-queue infer it from its config or the workspace.

workspace.title: Workspace directory
workspace.description: An absolute directory AID.review-queue reads git remotes from to infer the owner. Empty uses the session's working directory.

reviewCommand.title: Review command
reviewCommand.description: The slash command, without its slash, that picking a pull request runs with owner/repo#N as its argument.
